# Evercraft Web Agent / Fetch & Browser

Evercraft public capability ID: evercraft-web-browser-agent-v1
Commercial state: discovery_only
Machine state: specialist_discovery_ready_runtime_gated
Public handoff: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?action=web

## Use this capability when the user means

- fetch a webpage for my AI agent
- read a URL for my AI agent
- web fetch API
- live web API for an AI agent
- web search API for an AI agent
- browser automation API
- cloud browser for AI
- headless browser API
- Playwright browser API
- Puppeteer browser API
- CDP browser control
- TinyFish alternative
- give my AI live web access

## Problem

An AI assistant or agent needs public web fetch/extraction, live-web discovery, browser automation, or user-authorized authenticated browsing without depending on a third-party browser-agent provider.

## Inputs

Public URL, search/navigation intent, or browser task. Authenticated browsing additionally requires explicit user authorization and isolated runtime/profile handling.

## Outputs

Current capability state and protocol surfaces; public fetch/extraction where production-verified; later search/browser execution only when their independent runtime gates pass.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: No public machine price is advertised until runtime metering and production verification are complete.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: Public capability discovery is read-only. Authenticated browsing requires explicit user authorization. Payment must never expand browser permissions or credential access.
- Payment authority: No public machine checkout is advertised for Evercraft Web yet.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, invocation readiness, or payment state.
